column2: Instant. Cultivate a nearby herb, growing a duplicate you can harvest without requiring Herbalism skill. Each herb may only be cultivated once.
Instantly attack the target causing 15% of Attack Power damage and healing you for 10% of your maximum health. Only useable within 20 sec after you kill a non-trivial enemy.
Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your attack power. In addition, the next 5 successful melee attacks will restore 10 health. This effect lasts 8 sec.
Instantly blasts the target for 118 to 132 Shadow damage. If the target dies within 8 sec of Shadowburn, and yields experience or honor, the caster gains a Soul Shard.
Instantly counterattack an enemy for 109 to 133 damage and a high amount of threat. Revenge must follow a block, dodge or parry.
Instantly heals a friendly target below 50% Health for 1,090 to 1,284 and removes Weakened Soul from that target. Cannot be cast on self.
Instantly heals a friendly target below 50% Health for 145 to 181 and removes Weakened Soul from that target. Cannot be cast on self.
Instantly heals the caster for 1,090 to 1,284.
Instantly heals the caster for 145 to 181.
Instantly shields you, absorbing 455 damage. Lasts 1 min. While the shield holds, spells will not be interrupted.
Instantly shocks the target with frost, causing 126 to 134 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 50%. Lasts 8 sec.

KingGizNtheLizardWiz pointed out that a streamer's camera sits right where the bottom-left talents are, and every cam is in a different corner. So on desktop there is now a Stream layout button next to Compare to Classic. Turn it on and a bar appears above the page: grab anywhere on it to slide the page sideways or down, pull the handle on the right to make it narrower or wider (never below 640px, so viewers can still read it), and reset puts it back. Your position is remembered on this browser; every visit still starts in the normal layout. The class banner also says talentsforever.com in the middle now, so viewers know where to find the build.

Lacerates the enemy target, making them bleed for 50 damage over 15 sec plus 10% weapon damage per existing application of Lacerate on the target. Causes a high amount of threat. This effect stacks up to 5 times on the same target.

Launches a bolt of frostfire at the enemy, causing 102 to 118 Frostfire damage, slowing movement speed by 40% and causing an additional 27 Frostfire damage over 9 sec. This spell will be checked against the lower of the target's Frost and Fire resists and counts as both Frost and Fire damage.
Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 113 Holy damage to an enemy, or 291 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.
Learned at level 1
Lets you train your pet with various abilities that you have learned how to teach.

Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning cast half a second faster than Classic before you spend a talent point, read from tooltips on Guzu's stream that u/Schiffers sent in. That is why Elemental Alacrity only trims 0.5 sec at 3 of 3: deep Elemental ends up right where Classic did. On the Shaman page under Abilities.
Lightning Bolt in the Shaman spellbook
Male counterpart to the Succubus, its own summon. Named by four Demonology talents.
Maximum Mana, Rage or Energy increased by 5%, whichever your class uses.
Mocking Blow in the Warrior spellbook
Moved along row 6 in Protection.
Moved from Protection row 6 to Protection row 5.
Moved from Restoration row 1 to Restoration row 4.
New Subtlety capstone. Each Rupture tick takes 3 Energy off your next Hemorrhage or Backstab, stacking to 5.
New finisher at the bottom of Assassination. Your poisons do 30% more and apply 10% more often, longer per combo point.
New little ability: decipher an untranslated scroll. Seen on a Skyborne Mage.
New out-of-combat resurrection, 10 sec cast. Rebirth keeps its 30 min cooldown.
New perk in Professions: Reduces the gold price of items from all vendors by 5%.
New talent, Assassination row 5. Hits with both weapons for 75% damage each, 20% more on poisoned targets, and gives 2 combo points. Nine other talents feed it.
New. Pick a spot up to 30 yd away and your totems move there, not just to your feet. Seen on Guzu's stream: a green circle on the ground, then the totems appear by the mob. Totemic Recall is in too.
New. Rank 1: 26 mana, 0.5 sec cast, 2 min cooldown. Confuses up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 3 sec. Any damage breaks it.
New. Rank 1: instant, 40 yd, 10 min cooldown. Heals a friendly target below 50% health for 220 to 257 and removes Weakened Soul from them. Cannot be cast on yourself.

New. Rank 2 at 38: 220 mana, instant, 30 yd, 10 min cooldown. Places a Holy ward on an ally for 15 sec; the next hit that drops them below 35% health gives them a 290 absorb and heals 338 over 15 sec. One per target. Rank 1 is 130 mana, 155 absorb, 300 heal.
New: drops up to four totems from your Totem Bar in one 3 sec cast.
Night Elf Priest
No longer needs Hack and Slash.
No longer needs Shadowburn.
Not hovered on a Rogue yet; Rogues wear the same two types as the Druid whose tooltip we read.

One button, two things. In the game shows what each beta build changed on the talent trees, class by class, with a small map of where it moved. On the site is the list you are reading, and some entries now open with a before and after picture of the thing that changed. Tap a build, a class, a bar or a card to go a layer deeper.
Passive. +2% critical strike chance with all spells and attacks, auto attacks included, while you have a sword or two-handed sword equipped. Read off Soda's Warrior tooltip.

Paste a build link in Discord, Reddit or X and the card now shows the class big in its colour, the build's main tree lit up, the tree art behind it, and the class emblem. Every class and every tree has its own card. The painted book that has always been the site's icon now sits in the masthead and the footer too, with a slow mist behind it. Hover it, or the class emblem, and they breathe.
Performs a feint, causing no damage but lowering your threat by a large amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.
Performs a feint, causing no damage but lowering your threat by a small amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.
Pinches an enemy's legs for 19 to 21 damage and reduces movement speed by 50% for 9 sec.
Place a Fire trap that will burn the first enemy to approach for 105 Fire damage over 15 sec. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Fire trap can be active at a time.

Place a Holy ward on an ally for 30 sec. The next time this ally takes damage dropping their Health below 35%, they will gain a shield absorbing 155 damage and begin healing for 125 Health over 15 sec. A target may be affected by only one Contingency Plan.

Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing the effects of Holy Light spells used on the target by up to 210 and the effect Flash of Light spells used on the target by up to 60. Lasts 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing total stats by 10% for 5 min. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
